holdings.name: Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF
holdings.risk: Falls with the whole US market; offers no shelter in a broad selloff.
holdings.thesis: Owns the entire US market at 0.03% a year — this is the compounding engine; everything else is seasoning.

holdings.name: Vanguard Total International Stock ETF
holdings.risk: Currency swings and long stretches of foreign underperformance can drag for years.
holdings.thesis: Owns the rest of the world's markets so the portfolio is not a bet on a single country.

holdings.name: Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF
holdings.risk: Loses value when interest rates rise; long stretches of meager real returns.
holdings.thesis: Investment-grade ballast that steadies the portfolio and funds rebalancing when stocks fall.

holdings.name: Microsoft Corp.
holdings.risk: Premium valuation — any growth disappointment gets punished fast.
holdings.thesis: Durable software franchises with recurring revenue and a genuine moat in cloud and productivity.

holdings.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Mfg.
holdings.risk: Geographic concentration in Taiwan is the single biggest tail risk in the book.
holdings.thesis: The world's foundry — nearly every advanced chip on earth runs through its fabs.

holdings.name: Johnson & Johnson
holdings.risk: Litigation overhang and patent cliffs can surprise even the steadiest names.
holdings.thesis: Defensive healthcare cash flows across pharma, medtech, and consumer health.

holdings.name: Procter & Gamble Co.
holdings.risk: Slow growth and private-label competition cap the upside.
holdings.thesis: Everyday products people buy in good times and bad; dividend aristocrat reliability.

holdings.name: Costco Wholesale Corp.
holdings.risk: Trades at a rich multiple — excellence is already in the price.
holdings.thesis: A membership model customers love, with pricing power most retailers can only envy.

holdings.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
holdings.risk: Credit cycles are unforgiving — recessions hit earnings and the stock together.
holdings.thesis: The best-capitalized big bank, built to gain share in every part of the cycle.

holdings.name: NextEra Energy, Inc.
holdings.risk: Rate-sensitive and capital-hungry; storm exposure is real.
holdings.thesis: Regulated utility growth plus a renewables pipeline; the portfolio's quiet compounder.

holdings.name: Honeywell International Inc.
holdings.risk: Cyclical; orders dry up exactly when the rest of the portfolio is hurting.
holdings.thesis: Industrial breadth — aerospace, automation, energy — tied to long-cycle capital spending.
